kill_criteria: retired: funding/step median below 1 over 21 steps (2026-09 and 2026-10 rolls) and every September window hedged with the futures blend negative after costs

legs: buy xyz:BRENTOIL (or xyz:CL) at the ask
sell the ICE Brent (NYMEX WTI) front/second-month blend the oracle tracks, re-weighted daily
mechanism: The XYZ Brent, WTI and gas oracles roll from the front to the second future a fifth of the way each day at the Globex reopen (22:00 UTC in US daylight time) on the 5th to 9th US business days of the month (roll_carry.roll_steps predicts the measured weight within 0.1 on 99% of hours). The book prices the blend ahead of the oracle, the premium builds to about -1% before each step and is charged as funding at half of premium/8 an hour, and the side the curve pays receives roughly the day’s roll-down. A futures hedge does not share the step, so funding minus step is the carry: a median 0.92/0.97/0.89 of the step for Brent/WTI/gas, i.e. slightly negative before costs.
name: Collect XYZ oil funding: long xyz:BRENTOIL and xyz:CL against a listed-futures hedge

quotes.note: retired: hedged with the futures blend the paid side earned -0.18%/-0.22%/-0.81% net per September roll window (Brent/WTI/gas); funding/step median 0.92/0.97/0.89 over 21 steps

risks: basis: the book can sit further below the oracle — the premium went −0.35% → −0.76% in three days, a 40bp mark-to-market loss against an oracle hedge, about one day of funding
the oracle is the deployer’s and unpublished: a methodology change, an outage or a slashing event re-marks the position
the hedge is off-venue: two margin accounts, a futures roll, and a blend that has to be re-weighted
funding decays the moment a second hedged arbitrageur arrives; the rate is the price of segmentation, not of risk
capacity is the ask side of one book at 25bp, not the OI cap headroom
measurement: the 09-10 quote assumed a step of a tenth of the spread; it is a fifth (the 22:00 UTC hourly premium straddles the step)
thesis: Retired 2026-10-09. The XYZ energy funding is the roll yield of a GSCI-style index, and the market prices it: hedged with the futures the oracle tracks, the paid side collects 0.89-0.97 of each roll step and loses money after costs. The 2026-09-10 thesis (the book sits below the oracle and the funding pays 250-400% a year to hold that gap) read the step at half its size.
